Our chef has traveled all over the world and has developed sensational flavours that will delight all your senses.  At Kara Mia, best traditional Italian halal food is served with a modern twist that will present an element of surprise with each and every bite. We invite you to come into our Italian halal food restaurant for a phenomenal culinary experience that will leave you ecstatic each and every time.

After several months of planning and hard work, we opened B BOYZ in July 2020. Opening up a restaurant had been always our dream and when we saw the chance we took it! Our team has years of culinary experience and we love mouthwatering food, which had inspired us to convert our dream into a reality. All of our burgers are made fresh and in our kitchen. Our burgers are marinated with our unique seasonings. Our meals are always prepared to perfection for you! All of our ingredients are locally sourced and all items are halal. If you have any questions regarding where we purchase our meat from, feel free to contact us and we will provide all details.
